address: 2-3 Stoney Street, Borough Market, Southwark, London, SE1 9AA, United Kingdom
bio: Situated at the entrance to the foodie wonderland that is Borough Market, this intimate French bistro is rooted in an ethos of unpretentious, pared-back cooking that perfectly suits its rustic interior design. The blackboard-written menu is regularly changing, and you can expect straightforward yet eminently satisfying dishes like pâté-en-croûte or whole mackerel with café de Paris butter. A friendly welcome and cheery service ensure you’ll be dining with a smile on your face....
